title: 河內塔
question:
有 A、B、C 三根柱子，A 上面有 n 個圓盤，由上到下是 1 號（最小）到 n 號（最大）。要把全部的圓盤搬到 C：一次只能搬最上面的一個，大的不能放在小的上面。
請寫一個模組 hanoi(n, from, to, via)，把 n 個圓盤從 from 搬到 to（via 是借放的柱子）：
1. 先把上面 n - 1 個從 from 搬到 via
2. 把 n 號盤從 from 搬到 to，輸出「n 號盤 from → to」
3. 再把那 n - 1 個從 via 搬到 to
n 是 0 就什麼都不用做。用一個全域變數數一共搬了幾步。
主流程輸入 n，執行 hanoi(n, "A", "C", "B")，最後輸出「共 幾 步」。

test_case.output:
1 號盤 A → B
2 號盤 A → C
1 號盤 B → C
共 3 步

1 號盤 A → C
共 1 步

1 號盤 A → C
2 號盤 A → B
1 號盤 C → B
3 號盤 A → C
1 號盤 B → A
2 號盤 B → C
1 號盤 A → C
共 7 步

en.title: Tower of Hanoi
en.question:
There are three poles A, B and C. Pole A has n disks, from disk 1 (smallest) on top to disk n (biggest) at the bottom. Move all the disks to C. Move only the top disk each time, and never put a big disk on a small one.
Make a module hanoi(n, from, to, via) that moves n disks from "from" to "to" ("via" is the spare pole):
1. Move the top n - 1 disks from "from" to "via"
2. Move disk n from "from" to "to", and output "Disk n: from → to"
3. Move those n - 1 disks from "via" to "to"
If n is 0, do nothing. Use a global variable to count the moves.
In the main flow, input n, run hanoi(n, "A", "C", "B"), and output "Moves: " and the count at the end.

test_case.output:
Disk 1: A → B
Disk 2: A → C
Disk 1: B → C
Moves: 3

Disk 1: A → C
Disk 2: A → B
Disk 1: C → B
Disk 3: A → C
Disk 1: B → A
Disk 2: B → C
Disk 1: A → C
Moves: 7
